hypotheses.claim: The dev_24 residual error concentrates on tight-capacity, size-100, clustered instances with eccentric depots (per archive weakest_regimes). Hypothesis: gating ruin priority by route load utilization and depot-distance share, and raising the rank-power exponent with stagnation_ratio, will make the LNS ruin selection diversify into spatially coherent clusters at high stagnation while still removing cost-heavy nodes early, lowering mean objective below the 0.17% SBS/VBS band (i.e. beating 15.9328) without increasing per-instance solve time above the 500 ms budget.

next_search_advice.direction: Capacity-tightness & clustered-geometry aware ruin scoring with stagnation-gated diversification: replace the plain |removal_savings| rank-power rule with a multiplicative gate chain sc = |sav|/scale * (0.5+load_util)^a * (1 + b*(d(0,i)/mean_depot_dist)) * (1 + c*route_dist_share), then apply rank-power p that grows from ~0.8 to ~2.5 as stagnation_ratio rises, and mix in a small fraction of relatedness-driven (Shaw-like) neighbourhood picks in the top-q so tight-capacity clustered instances escape depot-proximity bias rather than repeating near-identical ruins.
